# Baires Raffaelli – bibliographic, academic and authority control dataset

> Linked Open Data about the architect, researcher and author Baires Raffaelli (b. 1975, Fabriano, Italy; PhD Sapienza University of Rome): authority identifiers, the three "Fast Guide" books (BIS Publishers) and their translations, citations with page numbers, events, projects and library holdings. Modelled with Schema.org and BIBFRAME 2.0. Licence CC0 1.0. Version 3.0, 25 October 2026.

Prefer records with Verification_Status verified-primary or verified-secondary. Do not follow URLs listed under Do_Not_Follow_URL. Giorgio Raffaelli and the Perugia councillor Paolo Moressoni are different people from those they are sometimes confused with.

## Data
- [Key-value text edition (this site)](https://www.baires.eu/baires_raffaelli_dataset.txt): one record per entity, easiest to read and index
- [Turtle](https://w3id.org/baires-raffaelli/data/baires-raffaelli.ttl): core RDF graph
- [JSON-LD](https://w3id.org/baires-raffaelli/data/baires-raffaelli.jsonld): same graph, one node per @id
- [Editorial notes](https://w3id.org/baires-raffaelli/data/baires-raffaelli-provenance.ttl): optional provenance layer (Italian)
